craft_notes: Sthāyin: armpit-sky (the strangest seat — kept plain). Rows: row 3 (mind-making→calm). Close: dissolving (layāt — the method-word returns). Rejected: 'chest-lock' — killed: armpit-sky kept (kakṣā-vyoman is the text's own compound); 'shoulders' — killed: arms two kept.

lines: armpit-sky mind-making — calm comes by dissolving.
l4.sanskrit_cite: upaviśyāsane samyag bāhū kṛtvārdhakuñcitau | kakṣavyomni manaḥ kurvan śamam āyāti tallayāt

reads_against.argmap: What calm comes from the arms? → Mind in the armpit-sky of the half-bent arms comes to calm.
c1_essence: Armpit-sky half-bent arms: calm by dissolving.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness at the edge of intensity)
